mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Evelynn has massively increased Attack Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Evelynn slashes her target twice, dealing damage with each hit. She then gains increased Attack Speed for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Evelynn slashes a target @NumberOfStrikes@ times, dealing a total of <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Evelynn then gains <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Camoflauge only being able to be seen by nearby enemy champions or true sight. While stealthed, she rapidly regenerates Mana.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Evelynn stealths into the shadows, gaining Camouflage and regenerates 1% max Mana every second.

Casting spells, taking damage or dealing damage removes Camouflage for 6 seconds.
Evelynn can only be seen by nearby enemy champions or by true sight.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Evelynn fires a line of spikes through an enemy, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Evelynn fires a line of spikes through a nearby enemy dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to all enemies in its path.

Hate Spike prioritizes targets Evelynn has recently attacked.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Evelynn summons spikes from the ground to deal damage and slow enemies in the area. She then gains a shield based on how many enemy champions were hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Evelynn impales all enemies in the targeted area, dealing @TotalDamage@% current Health magic damage and Slowing them by @Slow*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Evelynn siphons their pain, gaining a @ShieldAmount@ Health Shield for each enemy champion hit which lasts up to 6 seconds.
Evelynn has massively increased Movement Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Evelynn passively increases her Movement Speed when hitting enemy champions with her spells. Upon activation, Evelynn breaks free from slows affecting her and gains a massive Movement Speed boost for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Evelynn's spell hits on enemy champions grant her @PassiveMS@ Movement Speed for @PassiveDuration@ seconds (effect stacks up to @MaxPassiveStacks@ times).

Active: Evelynn removes all slows affecting her and gains @ActiveMS*100@% Movement Speed for @ActiveDuration@ seconds.

Champion takedowns refresh Dark Frenzy's cooldown.
Evelynn is increasing her Movement Speed in combat.
